title: Instruments with declared audio inputs across the format adapters

needles: the Sidechain bus a second declared input bus maps to

installed_sdk.rationale: The LV2 instance gains an adapter-internal field that the LV2 entry's run() reads to split the flat input ports into main and side chain; no sequencer capability, timeline type, or playback symbol is added to the installed SDK.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No timeline CLI verb, flag, or handler changes; the change is plug-in format bus plumbing.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: Audio-input bus exposure for instruments is host routing, not a musician-facing control or operation.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No capability key or design-time manifest is added or changed.
